source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
In your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), pick **ADEPTUS MECHANICUS** units of yours (at least 1), embarked ones within **TRANSPORTS** included. The most you can pick depends on battle size:

- 1 at Incursion
- 2 at Strike Force
- 3 at Onslaught

Until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, the picked units have the **HALO OVERRIDE** keyword. Next, pick 1 Override ability, which your **HALO OVERRIDE** units have for the same period:

- **Electromotive Energisation**: +2" Move for the unit's models.
- **Microactuator Bracing**: +1 Toughness for the unit's models.
- **Predation Protocols**: the unit may declare a charge even if it made an **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** this turn.
- **Muted Servomotors**: the unit's models have **[Stealth](vsdata:core-ability/stealth)**.
